findings.severity: low (disclosed as 'a pattern check, not a proof'; no released value affected)
findings.detail: The extended AST scan (tests/test_p17.py::scan) now flags named-function and lambda replace, eval/exec, parse_expr, lambdify, any .eval(, .func( rebuilds, and lists every sympify/S call without a 'd' local as a parse site (24 sites, all on PARSE_SITES_REVIEWED, none stale). Planted value paths it does NOT catch: Poly(e, d)(4) and e.as_poly(d)(4) (Poly.__call__, the same hazard class as the disclosed 'Poly(..).eval'), Horner evaluation of Poly(..).all_coeffs(), type(x)(*args) / x.__class__(*args) rebuilds (same class as e.func(*args)), getattr indirection, an aliased import (from sympy import sympify as sy), sympify(text, locals={'d': Symbol('d')}) (the 'guarded' test is syntactic: any dict literal with key 'd' passes), and plain Symbol('d') creation. All leak a value at runtime. My own grep of code/p5_calc + code/p5_entry finds none of these patterns (Symbol('d') only in docstrings and in the deliberate release_p17.f3_hardening probe; both locals={'d': ...} sites bind dred.d).

P17_hh_slot.json slot_values lists Q4S, QdS(hat), c tilde/h hat, c tilde/h mixed, c hat/h mixed, all tilde, but not c hat/h tilde. There, by the certificate's own Q4S formula, X_D01 = p.p^2 a~.b~ c^.p/16 = -X_D03, i.e. each graph reaches the slot purely through the evanescent gt_rs p_n structure (my own run: nonzero for D01, D03, zero for the sum). The verdict is unaffected because p_m(G_D01+G_D03) = 0 identically (all assignments), and H4 already holds via Q4S.

dred.py OpaqueDimension.matches comment still says 'tests/test_p16.py scans the package code' (the p17 scan is in tests/test_p17.py; the module docstring is correct). p17_conventions.PARSE_SITES_REVIEWED header says each site 'receives a sympy object (never a stored string)', but 7 of 24 entries parse stored strings (6 export prefactor strings, 1 classical srepr); the per-entry notes are accurate and I verified all 9 exported prefactor strings and the ell2/3/4 srepr exports contain no d.

pdftotext of the appendix contains no ASCII apostrophe; all 630 are U+2019. The P17_hh_slot p_dot_G keys ("(('g', '4', 'n', 'r'), ...)") and code listings therefore are not byte-copyable from the PDF. The package VALUE_BLOCKS contain no such key and read back exactly; my extended hh-slot snippets (39) read back in order only after folding U+2019 to an ASCII apostrophe.
dred.parse_d(srepr(e)) raises PlainDimensionSymbol (srepr round-trips are not supported by the loader); it fails closed, so this is safe, but it is not documented.

The hh-slot check starts from my p16 own D01/D03 results (own fit of the exported covariant integrands, not my own Feynman-rule derivation of the integrands). D11 (same row) is unevaluated (M2 undischarged), so the row's slot remains open as the certificate states. The summed evanescent poles of the hh Green function (8 structures, equal to my own) are nonzero but transverse; the hh Green function itself would need evanescent h.h counterterms outside this projection (not claimed). The overall phase (G6) is now documented (PHASE_CONVENTION_G6); D01/D03 relative phase is constrained by the decoupling (M1 breaks it); D13 vs hh relative phase is untested, as disclosed.
